summary_en: Kumiai Chemical will acquire three consolidated subsidiaries—Ihara Kensei Kogyo, Kumika Logistics, and Nihon Printing—through fixed-ratio stock exchanges becoming effective November 1, 2026. Exchange ratios use a variable method tied to Kumiai's average share price in a specified period before the effective date; the ratio for Ihara Kensei is set at 1,543 yen divided by Kumiai's average share price. The transaction streamlines group decision-making and strengthens consolidated operations.
title_en: Notice Regarding Complete Subsidiary Status of Three Consolidated Subsidiaries Through Simplified Stock Exchange
translation_en_brief:
Kumiai Chemical Industry announced it will acquire three consolidated subsidiaries—Ihara Kensei Kogyo, Kumika Logistics, and Nihon Printing—through simplified stock exchanges. The transaction will make each subsidiary a wholly-owned subsidiary of Kumiai Chemical, effective November 1, 2026. The Board of Directors resolved on September 11, 2026, to execute stock exchange agreements with each subsidiary on the same date.

The exchange will employ a variable-ratio method. Under this approach, the value of each target subsidiary is fixed at the decision date, and the number of Kumiai Chemical ordinary shares to be allocated for each ordinary share of the target companies is determined based on Kumiai Chemical's average share price during a specified period immediately preceding the effective date. For Ihara Kensei, the exchange ratio is calculated as 1,543 yen divided by Kumiai Chemical's average ordinary share price; ratios for the other two subsidiaries will be disclosed separately once determined. Kumiai Chemical's average share price remains unconfirmed as of the announcement.

These transactions are classified as simplified stock exchanges under the Companies Act Section 796(2) because the target subsidiaries are already consolidated subsidiaries. Accordingly, Kumiai Chemical shareholder approval is not required, though shareholder approval by each target company is scheduled for October 15, 2026. The company stated the primary purpose is to strengthen group operations by accelerating decision-making and enhancing operational efficiency and flexibility in response to the highly fluid business environment.
